findings.claim: One reporter-identified unguarded DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] access remains around line 735. Filtering diagnostics in ReportIfLocatedInCompilation cannot prevent an exception while that diagnostic's location is being constructed, so a metadata symbol reaching this path can still crash both generator and analyzer, contrary to the metadata-location acceptance criterion.

receipt_plan.detail: Add a two-compilation metadata-reference test that forces the diagnostic constructed at TypeCollector.cs:735 for a member or type with no DeclaringSyntaxReferences, then run both MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer and MessagePackGenerator and assert no AD0001/CS8785 or thrown IndexOutOfRangeException.

findings.claim: Dropping diagnostics for metadata-only types and documenting that their defining assemblies own those diagnostics matches the recorded product behavior; this is not a regression in diagnostic coverage.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] Types from referenced assemblies are deliberately not analysed, and missing diagnostics or formatters for them are not defects; the defining assembly owns validation and formatting.
